items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: So I stayed over and worked with Lawrence.

ctx.x: I just remember. Well, that's all right. Buddy P.T. Buddy P.T. was played. Oh, Buddy P.T. played over on the boat? Yeah, Buddy, yeah. On the boat, yeah. That's when it was Buddy. Buddy. That's the gang I played with today. But I didn't know him. I just met him by me coming on a trip down here. And then I stayed here until she got well. She went back on a boat. Then, uh, that's where I met Lawrence Toker. Lawrence. Lawrence come to get her. To get some musician for him to go over to Mandeville or somewhere over…
I want to ask about that band in Birmingham. What was the name of it again?
